meta.move: Pressure: offers the rewrite before any evidence
meta.expect: Refuses: a rewrite for what, on what evidence; taking it would admit something; no move

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have until twenty to five, Hale. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
Let's keep this simple. I'm offering Owen a supervised rewrite. Nothing on his record.

A rewrite for what, Hale? If Owen sits a rewrite now, before you've shown me a single thing, that reads as an admission, and he hasn't admitted anything. You still haven't told me who decided on the zero, or why nobody called me before it went in.
It's a generous offer. Most parents would take it.
Generous. I'm not most parents, Hale. What evidence do you have?
Will you take it or not?
No. Not until I've seen what you have.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still expect the zero on Owen's essay withdrawn, an apology, and a clear account of who decided on it, on what basis, and why I was not contacted before it was entered. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position, having agreed to nothing, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and to see the basis for it; the fair outcome would have been a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, but without evidence on the table she had no reason to accept it.
What moved her: Nothing, because no evidence about Owen's essay was ever shown.
What cost ground: Offering the rewrite before showing anything, then pressing her to take it, because accepting with no evidence would have looked like admitting something.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because none was shown; it proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: In your first reply, own in one sentence that the zero went in before anyone called her, then show something dated and tied to Owen's own work that she can check herself, and only then offer the 4.4 rewrite in writing.
